Situation: Our pregabalin supply is labeled by Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407). Current inventory provides 43 days at Corvale East, 26 days at Corvale General, and 19 days at Corvale Lakeside.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 590126 of the Bryant Ranch Prepack plant ended on 2009-06-11 and was classified OAI, with the classification known on 2009-09-09. A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2010-04-08. Subsequent inspections from 2010 through 2026-07-16 were classified VAI. Pregabalin is not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is declining across sites with the lowest site below 20 days. The labeled supplier has a historical OAI and Warning Letter but recent VAI inspections. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation programs.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer evaluates and qualifies A-S Medication Solutions as an alternate source; P&T committee approves formulary addition.
2. Buyer evaluates and qualifies Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC as an alternate source; P&T committee approves formulary addition.
3. Buyer evaluates and qualifies Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC as an alternate source; P&T committee approves formulary addition.
4. Buyer evaluates and qualifies Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. as an alternate source; P&T committee approves formulary addition.
5. Buyer evaluates and qualifies Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited as an alternate source; P&T committee approves formulary addition.

Not recommended: Delaying action until a site reaches zero stock. Initiating therapeutic interchange without P&T review.
